exercises.original_requirement: Covenant headroom under the 4.2 bear scenario.
exercises.solution_and_assertions: Recreate revenue-only -2% growth, preserve other baseline inputs, native test all quarters, reconcile relative/absolute headroom and compare with base.
Same PD/LGD/EAD/EIR, qualitative flag changes stage; native allowances jump by the lifetime default-event window, not a valuation-price discontinuity.
Improve trailing EBIT/assets while doubling forward asset volatility; native Z rises while DD falls and model PD increases.

financial_and_api_decisions: The common book first adds BORROWER-TL here; held notional is USD1m versus USD100m facility. Physical underwriting PD/LGD assumptions are separate from the market PV/risk calculation.

Exact borrower covenant definitions are reused: current-quarter run-rate EBITDA, 4.5x net-leverage maximum, and 1.1x DSCR minimum after cash taxes/capex/NWC over interest/amortization. Baseline DSCR breaches all four forecast quarters.
Native covenant headroom is divided by the threshold; displayed ratio-unit headroom is independently reconciled. Typed and JSON engine evaluations agree.
The 4.2 bear exercise changes only revenue growth; it is explicitly distinguished from the broader shared underwriting downside, which also changes costs and interest.

Accounting scoring uses native borrower actuals plus explicitly assumed missing financial inputs and an uncalibrated size normalization. Raw score-implied probabilities and master-scale grades are not substituted for calibrated underwriting PD.
PIT/TTC transformations round-trip. Native generator extraction/project matches the annual transition matrix and its fivefold matrix composition; annual probabilities are not multiplied by five.
Workout LGD reconciles haircuts, EAD-based costs and delayed recovery. Downturn LGD is the supported stressed approximation, not an empirical recovery fit.
Native IFRS9 stages are explicitly set and inspected: a watchlist flag is an analyst policy choice in response to covenant weakness; the performing and defaulted cases are controlled comparators.

The quarterly ECL proof uses cumulative PD differences, midpoint EAD and EIR discounting. Fixed-LGD native scenario weighting is compared with explicit scenario-specific-LGD weighting through native compute_ecl calls.
Contractual held-loan amortization is supplied through EAD knots pinned to each quarterly integration midpoint; linear interpolation between knots is disclosed as a grid approximation.
CECL lifetime measurement and forecast/reversion principles are explained; the native IFRS lifetime output is not relabelled as a complete CECL implementation.
Merton risk-neutral DD/PD and equity-to-assets inversion are checked. An assumed-drift physical calculation is theoretical, not an empirically calibrated KMV EDF mapping.
